column8: A very common variant. Having one or two copies is frequent in many populations and is not a diagnosis on its own.
Studied in hereditary haemochromatosis (iron overload). Relevance depends on carrying two copies and on iron tests such as ferritin and transferrin saturation; ask a clinician.
A common HFE variant, usually of small effect on its own.
One of the two positions that define APOE e2/e3/e4. Calling the APOE type needs both positions and their phase; this tool reports each position separately.

Lies in an enhancer of the lactase gene LCT. The A allele (written -13910T on the gene strand) is associated with lactase persistence in people of European ancestry.
The A allele (CYP1A2*1F) is associated with higher inducibility of CYP1A2, an enzyme that breaks down caffeine.
Common in the general population. Two copies mean no alpha-actinin-3 protein in fast muscle fibres.
